env.up: v=0 is up (zenith), v=0.5 horizon, v=1 nadir
env.dir_to_uv: camera space d (x right, y up, z towards viewer): u = 0.5 + atan2(d.x, -d.z) / (2*pi), v = 0.5 - asin(d.y) / pi
env.origin: bubble position, 1.2 m in front of the camera, 12 cm above the lens axis; same orientation as the main camera

color: sRGB display-referred (Blender AgX view transform baked in); black velvet studio, one softbox
note: Studio: black velvet backdrop, no sun. The key is one large rectangular softbox (5000 K, warm-neutral) up-left BEHIND the camera; 'sun_dir' points from the bubble position to its centre in camera space. 'sun' is not the light itself (it is behind the lens) but where its mirrored highlight sits on a bubble at the bubble position (upper-left). It is a big soft source: a broad, rounded-rectangle window highlight, not a point (angular size in key_light.angular_rad, width x height). env.jpg is black except the softbox and a thin strip light behind the camera on the right, so the thin-film colours carry the bubbles.

key_light.name: softbox
key_light.azimuth_convention: 0 = from the bubble towards the camera, negative = camera-left
